causes.quote: Together these network outages limited imports into New South Wales.

interconnectors_named.name: Vic-NSW
interconnectors_named.quote: A planned outage on the Canberra to Upper Tumut line forced flows from New South Wales into Victoria across the Vic-NSW interconnector

interconnectors_named.name: QNI
interconnectors_named.quote: a short notice outage was required on an Armidale to Bulli Creek transmission line limiting transfers into New South Wales from Queensland across the QNI

interconnectors_named.name: Terranora
interconnectors_named.quote: The ongoing partial outage of the Terranora interconnector set its capability to around 100 MW of imports from Queensland to New South Wales.

intervals.quote: On 23 September 2015, the spot price in New South Wales exceeded $5000/MWh for the 6.30 pm and 7 pm trading intervals.

network_outages.quote: Network outages contributed to the outcomes during the day.

peak_price.quote: The spot price in New South Wales reached $13 420/MWh and $ 6717/MWh for the 6.30 pm and 7 pm trading intervals respectively.

rebid_set_price.quote: There was no significant rebidding of capacity from low to high prices that contributed to the high priced outcomes.
